svg.title: RTP: a 12-byte header, then the payload
svg.desc: The RTP packet of frame 624 of wireshark_aaa.pcap, 32 bits per row: a first byte 0x80 for version 2, no padding, no extension and no CSRC, a second byte 0x08 for a clear marker bit and payload type 8, sequence number 28590, timestamp 1240, the SSRC 0x3796cb71, then 160 bytes of payload; RtpPacket keeps the version, the marker, the payload type, the sequence number, the timestamp, the SSRC, an empty CSRC list, no extension, the payload as bytes and a padding length of 0.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
